column1: # Commands the classifier must flag. Format: risk<TAB>command. Lines starting with # are comments.
# A literal \n in a command is a newline. Write \\n for a backslash followed by n.
# Assertions run with home=/Users/dev, cwd=/Users/dev/project, stateDir=/Users/dev/.sayso.
# Some lines are adapted from the test suite of kenryu42/claude-code-safety-net (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 J Liew).
# destructive_command_guard was not used: its license rider withholds all rights from Anthropic and its agents.

column2: if true; then rm -rf x; fi
for f in a; do rm -rf $f; done
while true; do rm -rf x; done
case a in a) rm -rf x;; esac
sudo -E env FOO=1 nohup rm -rf x
for f in $(rm -rf x); do echo $f; done
sqlite3 d.db "delete from t where id=1; delete from u"
for c in "rm -rf /" ls; do eval "$c"; done
for d in x /; do rm -rf $d; done
for f in *.txt; do rm -rf $f; done
for f in a b; do for g in c; do rm -rf $f/$g; done; done
